facts: The July Revolution of 2024 was sparked by students demanding fair civil service quota reforms.
Peaceful demonstrations were met with force, transforming the movement into a mass uprising uniting citizens across all walks of life.
Despite severe internet blackouts and curfews, the collective resilience of ordinary people prevailed.
Countless individuals—students, workers, and professionals—made tremendous sacrifices, forever altering the nation's trajectory.
sources: Historical narratives drawn from eyewitness accounts of the July-August 2024 uprising in Bangladesh.
Composite experiences reflecting reports from Dhaka's hospitals, university campuses, and streets.
dedication: Dedicated to the enduring spirit of those who risked everything for justice and a fairer tomorrow.
